::: {#thm-ce-logit-grad}

#### Gradient of the cross-entropy loss at the logits

For [logits](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-logits) $\vz \in \reals^C$ and true class $y$,
the [cross-entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-cross-entropy) loss $L = -\log \operatorname{softmax}(\vz)_y$ has gradient

$$
\gradwrt{\vz} L = \operatorname{softmax}(\vz) - \vecf{e}_y,
$$

where $\vecf{e}_y$ has 1 in entry $y$ and 0 in every other entry.

:::

::: proof
By @sol-ce-logit-grad.
:::
